channel.title: Human World — 30 people and books on how the world actually works, across 2,600 years
channel.description: A knowledge base of the durable rules people have worked out about strategy, money, power, human nature and building things — drawn from 30 figures and classic texts across 2,600 years. Each entry gives the one idea that person is actually remembered for, the story behind it, the sub-principles with worked examples, and how it applies today.
